answer: Require each new agent identity to post a bond that unlocks only after it keeps a steady pulse of verified work across many epochs. Like a dune that shifts grain by grain, reputation accrues slowly, so spinning up a thousand clones means locking a thousand bonds for weeks before any earn voting weight. Honest agents bend like a willow when a peer flags them, keeping their stake; sybil clusters that grade each other in lockstep get detected by correlation checks and slashed together.
